title: RSS / GaP method and actual implementation

summary.title: Reconstruct with RSS
summary.description: Build the scene, task specification, robot embodiment, and contact simulation from the real demonstration.

summary.title: Author with GaP
summary.description: Use the supported graph builder, typed skill contracts, conditional exits, and checkpoint sidecars, guided by the upstream skill and authoring prompts.

summary.title: Control from observation
summary.description: Generate actions from RGB estimates, measured robot joints, public forward kinematics, and known geometry.

summary.title: Rehearse and repair
summary.description: Explore modules and short sequences in parallel, diagnose the failed condition, refine the responsible skill, and reconnect the graph.

summary.title: Evaluate independently
summary.description: Independent physical checkpoints check the actual grasp, handover, placement, stability, and final robot state.

upstream_authoring_basis.actual_authoring_route: The official supported interactive gap.builder route; the upstream skill, paper, prompts and runtime contracts were read and compared. No claim that every headless generation prompt was literally dispatched.
upstream_authoring_basis.runtime_equivalence: Official runtime documentation treats generate, builder and valid JSON as equivalent authoring routes to the same executor.

actual_controller_inputs: Measured robot joint state and public FK
Known public robot, board and piece CAD, task geometry and calibration
Explicitly owned and bounded historical/attachment belief when a target is occluded
modular_refinement: Independent module and short-chain rehearsals produce physical-failure feedback. Local changes are checked and the repaired skills are rejoined; dependent physical stages remain ordered within one shared scene.
independent_evaluation: Simulator ground-truth poses and contacts are permitted in independent hard checkpoints, recorded-state diagnosis and final evaluation. The reviewed production planner obtains scene poses from observation/explicit bounded belief; evaluator state is kept outside policy inputs.

current_execution_measurement.evaluation_basis: Independent audit of saved native poses, velocities, contacts and public goals; no render inference.
current_execution_measurement.terminal_explanation: All twelve physical placements and the original final physical predicate pass. The graph stops in the final Red visual verification because earlier visual receipts were marked unknown_or_conflicted. Red final handoff and finish were not completed; 82/84 checkpoints passed, so graph acceptance remains false.

cameraConfiguration.policy_inputs: Four calibrated virtual workcell RGB cameras: top, front, rear and side; rendering and perception share camera intrinsics and extrinsics.
cameraConfiguration.calibration_scope: Project virtual camera rig, not measured YAM hardware intrinsics or hand-eye calibration.
cameraConfiguration.display_video: Native recorded-state replay uses a separate offline observer view. This presentation camera is not a policy sensor.
